6 A shuttle disk, through Semantic Unison

A shuttle disk carries new photographs from a laptop to the archive. Semantic Unison synchronizes it with the archive’s tree. When only metadata changed, it sends the XMP packet, not the image, and checks with the preserved digest that nothing else moved. Before the shuttle is emptied, Unison preserves what it brought into a DNG Compare archive with the same layout, so a refilled path later gets a new version rather than overwriting the old one. dngc versions lists them and dngc restore --version rebuilds any of them.
